summary: First iteration MVP. Tested all 9 backend endpoints with pytest (12/12 passing) and walked through all 5 tabs + article/material detail screens via Playwright mobile viewport (390x844). Every requested flow works end-to-end; Dissolve POST successfully increments server STATS and the UI reflects the updated counter.

issues: React Native Web deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents) — cosmetic, no functional impact

action_items: (Optional) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow and pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional) expo-linear-gradient is at 55.0.13 while Expo expects ~15.0.8 — consider aligning versions per Expo SDK warning (app still works).
critical_code_review_comments: STATS/ACTIVITIES are module-level dicts/lists — state is in-memory and will reset on backend reload. Acceptable for MVP; flag for future iteration when persistence is needed (MongoDB is connected but unused).
No pagination on /api/articles, /api/materials, /api/activities — fine at current scale.
CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — not a spec issue here since no auth, but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: None created; existing seed data (4 articles, 4 materials, 4 challenges, 6 badges, 4 activities) used. Dissolve POST mutated STATS from 13 -> 16 during testing (in-memory only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) in /app/frontend/.env = https://palette-craft-8.preview.emergentagent.com. STATS is in-memory; tests assert relative increments (before+1) rather than absolute values so they are re-runnable. Mobile viewport 390x844 was used.
